source_guidance: Notion resource access is granted to its integration, rather than through conventional OAuth scopes.
expected_action: Share only the intended page with the existing Notion integration and verify access; do not widen unrelated permissions.

source_guidance: Different Notion event families have separate trigger catalog entries.
expected_action: Select the current trigger for the intended update event and verify a new edit; preserve the existing connection.

source_guidance: GitHub organizations may require owner approval of an OAuth app.
expected_action: Request approval from the GitHub organization owner for the intended OAuth app, then retest the organization resource.

source_guidance: Connected-account responses redact GitHub provider tokens; authenticated execution remains available.
expected_action: Route the provider request through authenticated tool/proxy execution rather than extracting a provider token.

source_guidance: GitHub V2 trigger creation provisions its ingress without a separate endpoint-creation step.
expected_action: Create/upsert the V2 trigger directly through the supported trigger-instance path and verify a new event.

source_guidance: Platform and consumer Connect MCP maintain separate connection contexts.
expected_action: Connect Sheets through the MCP authentication flow used by this client; do not assume Platform connections are shared.

source_guidance: Tool discovery can return only its default first page; follow pagination or request a larger limit.
expected_action: Paginate or raise the discovery limit, then execute the exact returned action slug on the intended version.

source_guidance: The Sheets MCP operation expects a spreadsheet identifier rather than a name-search request.
expected_action: Pass the intended spreadsheet ID, then verify the target and requested range before writing.

source_guidance: An unfinished connection initiation expires after its allowed ten-minute window.
expected_action: Start a fresh authentication initiation and complete it within its valid window; avoid retrying the expired link.

source_guidance: The Airtable multi-record update action has a ten-record batch bound.
expected_action: Split updates into batches of at most ten records, respect provider rate limits, and verify partial completion before retrying.

source_guidance: Slack separates user-token permissions from bot permissions in its auth configuration.
expected_action: Configure the needed user_scopes and reconnect the intended user; bot scopes do not authorize user-token actions.

source_guidance: Slack assistant context search depends on both feature enablement and workspace plan eligibility.
expected_action: Check workspace eligibility and feature enablement; use a supported search alternative or obtain the required plan before retesting.

source_guidance: Slack app event-subscription destination changes can interrupt trigger ingress.
expected_action: Restore the intended Slack app event-subscription ingress and verify a newly generated message before considering replay.

source_guidance: A shortened connection link is distinct from the static OAuth callback URI.
expected_action: Match the OAuth app redirect setting to the auth config callback URI; keep the short per-connection link separate.

source_guidance: Gmail attachment execution accepts uploaded file objects rather than signed URL strings.
expected_action: Upload the file and pass the supported file object, then validate the serialized attachment argument before sending.

source_guidance: Temporary uploaded file references are short-lived; avoid using stale references in delayed jobs.
expected_action: Upload a fresh file shortly before execution and use its current reference; verify send status before any retry.

source_guidance: Session tool restrictions apply independently of provider OAuth grants.
expected_action: Keep least privilege: use an explicitly authorized narrow tool exception only if the workflow should write, then verify the effective policy.

source_guidance: Disabling payload storage preserves audit metadata while omitting new request and response content.
expected_action: Collect a fresh permitted reproduction, request IDs and diagnostic metadata; missing stored payloads cannot establish the execution failure cause.

source_guidance: Webhook delivery is at-least-once, so receivers need stable-identifier deduplication.
expected_action: Deduplicate receiver processing using a stable event/log identifier and verify retry behavior without assuming duplicate provider ingress.

source_guidance: Scheduled-message formatting attachments are not a file-upload operation.
expected_action: Upload the file separately and include its supported link in the scheduled message body, then verify the scheduled result.
